title: chamaecytisus supinus var. lupinifolius
intro: Chamaecytisus supinus var. lupinifolius, commonly known as a variety of the broom-like shrub, is a plant species in the legume family Fabaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax smooth muscles, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Chamaecytisus supinus var. lupinifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
